body:
oncall-bot: ALERT 2169876543 - streaming.v1 endpoint: sustained 5xx spikes and token cadence stalls detected across several backends. kv_cache memory growth abnormal (+47% over baseline). auto-escalation to on-call.

maria (on-call): I'm on it. seeing error rate ~8% on streaming for region us-west-2, latency spikes to 1.8s per token. KV cache size metric shows large set churn. Paging events increasing.

ajay (runtime): observed continuous-batching windows spiking to 256ms (should be ~32ms), batching amplification happening. looks like the batching controller missed a cadence reset after a partial-flush path hit. Payload: ~60% long-context requests.

lin (sre): can we identify a recent config or rollout? any recent kernel/quant change?

maria (on-call): No infra rollouts in the last 6h. prod deploys: deploy-bot reports: 2169869000 -> resource-scheduler patch (non-batching), 2169872000 -> model-selector minor. nothing obvious.

deploy-bot: deploy 2169872000 succeeded to 80% canary, promoted at 2169873600. No rollback recorded.

ajay (runtime): suspect controller tweak from runtime PR #3124 changed default batch_hold_ms for streaming shadow routes. If batch_hold_ms increased, continuous batching will wait longer and push more keys into KV cache before flushing -> eviction churn.

devin (prod-eng): Maria, can you toggle the streaming cadence fallback to legacy short-poll for affected nodes while we debug? We want to stop cache blowup quickly.

maria (on-call): Doing a controlled toggle on the canary pool now: 
```
# trigger: routing flag
curl -X POST https://controlplane/internal/flags/streaming_cadence_fallback -d '{"pool":"canary-usw2","value":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```

maria (on-call): Flag applied to canary. Monitoring... 2m

lin (sre): After fallback: requests per second dropped slightly (expected), 5xx down to 3.2%, token latency trending toward baseline. KV cache growth stopped on canary nodes. Good signal.

eva-support: Heads up - Support is seeing multiple customers in us-west experiencing truncated streams and reconnect loops (CSAT impact). Customer IDs: C-8821, C-9910, C-10234. Notified account teams.

ajay (runtime): Plan: revert the unintended batch_hold_ms change and push hotfix to streaming controller. Hotfix will set batch_hold_ms back to 32ms and reduce max_batch_window to 64ms for streaming paths. Also add guard: if kv_cache_mem > 70% then force partial flush.

maria (on-call): Can you draft the exact patch so we can ship ASAP? I can coordinate deployment and oncall rollback steps.

ajay (runtime): Patch snippet: 
```
// runtime controller: streaming policy
policy.batch_hold_ms = config.streaming.default_batch_hold_ms; // revert to 32
policy.max_batch_window_ms = 64;
if (metrics.kv_cache_mem_pct > 70) {
  trigger_partial_flush();
}
```

ajay (runtime): Running unit + small integration locally, then will build canary image. ETA 25m.

lin (sre): Meanwhile escalate paging thresholds: reduce kv_cache retention TTL from 10m -> 3m for streaming partitions to encourage eviction of cold prefixes. This is a short-lived mitigation.

maria (on-call): I'll apply TTL change via runtime-config for affected regions. Doing us-west-2 now.

maria (on-call): TTL change applied. On canary the KV eviction rate increased, cache size back to expected. Monitoring 5m window.

deploy-bot: build 2169880130 created for runtime-controller hotfix, canary rollout initiated.

ajay (runtime): Canary metrics look good: 5xx ~1.1%, token latency stable. Pushing to region-wide in 10m if no regressions.

devin (prod-eng): Good. Eva, coordinate with CS to inform affected customers about mitigation and ETA for full rollout. Mention that we toggled fallback and applied TTL change; hotfix will be rolled to all nodes in ~10-15m.

eva-support: Noted, sending comms now. Draft to accounts: "We observed streaming disruptions due to a batching controller config regresssion causing elevated memory and partial flush stalls. We've toggled a fallback and are rolling a hotfix. Expect service restoration across regions within 30 minutes. We're following up with a post-incident summary." :white_check_mark:

maria (on-call): Full rollout started. I'll keep this thread updated.

lin (sre): After region-wide rollout: global 5xx back to baseline (~0.4%), streaming reconnection rate normalized. KV cache memory returned to typical 12GB usage. Partial flush counter reset to normal.

maria (on-call): Marking incident mitigated at 2169880200. No persistent data loss. Impact: increased latency and truncated streams for ~3 enterprise customers for ~45 minutes.

devin (prod-eng): Post-incident action items:
- ajay: PR to revert batch default and add guard (include unit tests) (owner: ajay)
- lin: add alert for continuous-batching batch_hold_ms drift vs baseline (owner: lin)
- maria: run canary stress test for long-context streaming load and validate TTL/eviction settings (owner: maria)
- eva-support: consolidate affected customers and QA comms + follow-up (owner: eva-support)

ajay (runtime): I'll open the PR now and link it here when ready.

maria (on-call): Thanks team. Adding incident label and creating retro ticket. We'll schedule a 1-hour postmortem tomorrow.

oncall-bot: Incident mitigated and handoff complete. Please file postmortem under incidents/rr/2169876543.
